# mwtl

Native Windows UI for C++20 with real HWND controls, typed events, explicit
ownership, DPI-aware layout, and a direct Win32 escape hatch.

Canonical coding-agent context:
https://github.com/everettjf/mwtl/blob/main/docs/agent-usage.md

Beginner tutorial (install, create, build, run, troubleshoot):
https://everettjf.github.io/mwtl/tutorial.html

Complete SDI Notepad tutorial:
https://everettjf.github.io/mwtl/notepad.html

Build workflow reference:
https://everettjf.github.io/mwtl/building.html

Full compact context:
https://everettjf.github.io/mwtl/llms-full.txt

Capability map:
https://github.com/everettjf/mwtl/blob/main/docs/capabilities.json

Templates:
https://github.com/everettjf/mwtl/tree/main/templates

Rules: Windows x64/ARM64, MSVC-compatible ABI, C++20. Controls own real HWNDs,
UI wrappers are thread-affine, workers use WindowWakeup, layout uses DIPs, and
unhandled events propagate.
